verdict.rationale: Sonar API is fundamentally a REST/API product with official Python SDK (sync and async clients, httpx/aiohttp), CLI tool returning JSON for shell pipelines/agent tool calls, retries/error handling, and an OpenAPI spec — all directly enabling headless/CI automation. Docs explicitly call out CLI output as 'ready for shell pipelines and agent tool calls, with no code to write.' Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions) or independent third-party report of running it in CI.
